treaties.folder_number: kpi:total, insight:supplements — unique per row; a letter suffix marks a follow-up instrument in an existing folder
treaties.Comment_for_website: skip: free-text notes, 96% empty; readable per row in the data explorer
treaties.Entry_into_force: chart-decades, chart-years, chart-lag, table:recent, insight:lag — year used when the signature date is missing
treaties.Date_of_Signature: chart-decades, chart-years, chart-regions, chart-newp, chart-heat, chart-lag, table:recent, kpi:span, insight:peak_decade, insight:decade_trend, insight:recent_leader, insight:new_partners, insight:lag
treaties.Treaty_Name: chart-forms, table:recent — English title; only its instrument word (agreement, convention, exchange of notes, ...) is used, the title itself is searchable in the explorer
treaties.Parties: chart-partners, chart-regions, chart-newp, table:recent, kpi:partners, insight:top_partner, insight:new_partners, insight:recent_leader — mapped to Hebrew names and regions
treaties.treaty: docs-note — links to the scanned text files; counted and typed by extension, not linked
